items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And they had a girl there named Bertha Hill, I think her name was. She had a sweet voice.

ctx.x: Yes. But what a tenor. He had one of the sweetest tenor voices you ever heard in your life. And they had a girl there named Bertha Hill, I think her name was. She had a sweet voice. Then you had May Alex She's another one used to run and do the split.
She worked with Jimmy Noone a lot.
